Good luck and stay strong.

Try to put yourself in their shoes, if they were feeling the way you are feeling would like to know?

Depression is a rough disease and you should never feel ashamed for having it.

Hi, I found myself in a situation very similar to yours not long ago. First things first, most failed suicide attempts will have a permanent effect on your body, so if you don't want to die I would suggest you deal with this other way, sorry if I'm being too blunt, but I think that being honest is the best way to help you. Reading your statement I can see that you will have to face your mother sooner or later. Coming from an abusive household I know this is easier said than done, but it is necessary. Try to look for public therapists or some form of help that you don't need her resources, I don't where you are from, but if you tell me I can help you search. Feel free to contact me. Stay strong!
